items.lede: Named “Volta-Autodoxer,” the recently uncovered malware uses AI tools to collect troves of data about victims, from login credentials and credit card numbers to Discord sessions and UberEats receipts.
items.title: Spooky New Infostealer Malware Uses AI to ‘Autodox’ Victims

items.lede: Cisco Talos says the VOLTA infostealer sends stolen victim data to Claude Opus 4.6 to rank assets by monetization value.
items.title: New AI-driven Windows malware feeds stolen data to Claude to rank victims’ assets by value, then deletes itself
